articles.title: ZDI-26-798: Meta FAIRChem dense_eval results-file Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-92211.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109619: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
articles.summary: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution. Affected product: PHP by PHP Group. Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes).

articles.title: CVE-2026-116016 — CVSS 7.1
articles.summary: yudao-cloud through 2026.09 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade row-level data scope restrictions by sending a data-permission-enable header set to false. Attackers can add this header to /admin-api requests, which DataPermissionRpcWebFilter trusts, to read or modify other departments' and users' records within the same tenant.

articles.title: CVE-2026-116014 — CVSS 8.1
articles.summary: open62541 1.5.0 before 1.5.7 contains an integer overflow in UA_DataType_fromStructureDescription() that wraps the 16-bit memSize field for large custom structure definitions. A malicious OPC UA server can supply DataType definitions via UA_Client_getRemoteDataTypes(), causing decodeBinaryStructure() to overflow the heap, crashing clients or enabling code execution.

articles.title: CVE-2026-116013 — CVSS 3.7
articles.summary: OpenResty lua-resty-dns before 0.24 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in parse_section() and _decode_name() that fails to check resource record lengths against the received message. Attackers controlling or spoofing a queried nameserver can send truncated record headers or RDATA, raising uncaught Lua exceptions in resolver:query() that abort requests and break name resolution.

articles.title: CVE-2026-116011 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Crow before 1.3.4 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in crow::json::load() that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to crash the server by sending deeply nested JSON. Attackers can send a request body with thousands of nested objects to exhaust the worker thread stack, terminating the process and dropping all connections.

articles.title: CVE-2026-116009 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: Camaleon CMS before 2.9.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users with only the media permission to write arbitrary files by supplying ../ sequences in the name parameter. Attackers can send a base64 data: URI to the crop_url media action to write an ERB template into a theme's views directory, which executes when rendered.

articles.title: CVE-2026-114429 — CVSS 6.8
articles.summary: The WPVR  WordPress plugin before 9.0.3 does not properly sanitise and escape some of its tour hotspot content before storing it and outputting it on the front end, which could allow users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks that execute in the browser of any user viewing the affected tour.

articles.title: CVE-2026-113674 — CVSS 3.7
articles.summary: The GeoDirectory  WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not correctly verify ownership of listings submitted by logged-out users before allowing them to be edited, allowing unauthenticated attackers to modify, unpublish, attach images to, or reassign any guest-submitted listing when guest posting is enabled.

articles.title: CVE-2026-113673 — CVSS 7.2
articles.summary: The GeoDirectory  WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not properly escape administrator-defined text before writing it into a generated PHP file in its own folder, allowing high privilege users such as a subsite administrator on a multisite network, who cannot otherwise run code, to achieve Remote Code Execution that any unauthenticated visitor can trigger.

articles.title: CVE-2026-113493 — CVSS 6.8
articles.summary: The GeoDirectory  WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not sanitise and escape some of its map shortcode attributes before outputting them within a style attribute, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks that execute in the context of any user viewing the affected content.

articles.title: CVE-2026-113492 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: The GeoDirectory  WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not perform status, ownership or password checks when loading listings for one of its unauthenticated AJAX handlers, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the content of non-public (draft, pending and private) listings by supplying their IDs.

articles.title: CVE-2026-113490 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: The GeoDirectory  WordPress plugin before 2.8.194 does not perform any status or ownership check when rendering a listing's map-popup through one of its single-item REST routes, allowing unauthenticated users to read the title, permalink and card fields of non-public (draft, pending, private and trashed) listings by supplying the listing ID.

articles.title: CVE-2026-112207 — CVSS 7.1
articles.summary: The Download Monitor WordPress plugin before 5.3.4 does not properly validate that a clicked link belongs to the site before fetching it client-side and rendering part of the response in the page, which allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who is tricked into clicking a crafted link.

articles.title: CVE-2026-110956 — CVSS 9.8
articles.summary: The asVereinbase  WordPress plugin before 1.1.8 does not require a valid password or a genuine second factor before authenticating a user, treating an empty stored value as a match, so an unauthenticated attacker can log in as any user, including an administrator.

articles.title: CVE-2026-107887 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: The Advanced Twenty Seventeen WordPress plugin through 1.3.1 does not perform any capability or nonce check on the action that creates and activates its bundled child , allowing any authenticated user such as a subscriber to switch the site's active  site-wide, and allowing the same action to be triggered against any logged-in user including an administrator via CSRF.
